_comment: Models the wall may switch vLLM to (NFCU Linode, 20 GB card). All open, none gated on Hugging Face. `args` are vLLM flags per model; `tools` = has a tool-call parser (the web toggle); `tokenizer` = HF repo for the chunk strip. Batch of 2026-09-26 (Simon: 'grab em all'): each booted once on the box with the wall's flags and answered with logprobs (trial log in JOURNAL); inclusionAI/Ling-3.0-tiny dropped (Triton shared-memory limit on Ada), XHToken/Spark-X2.5-4B dropped (architecture not in vLLM 0.30).

models.label: Qwen3 14B
models.note: same family, nearly twice the size, 4-bit, thinking off

models.label: Qwen3 4B
models.note: half the size — faster, more coin-flips

models.label: Gemma 4 12B
models.note: Google's open family, 4-bit — a different lineage from Qwen

models.label: Gemma 4 E4B
models.note: the small Gemma, built for phones and laptops

models.label: gpt-oss 20B
models.note: OpenAI's open model — 20B on disk, ~4B awake per token; reasons before it answers

models.label: Nemotron 3 Nano 4B
models.note: NVIDIA, hybrid transformer + state-space; thinks out loud in <think> tags first, so a 2,000-token leash
